t.zh: 「或者」层层嵌套，每一层都要选一边，要走几步事先不知道。重复框只顺着第一种结果走，进了死胡同就停下。
t.en: “Or” within “or”: each level needs a side chosen, and how many steps it takes is not known beforehand. The repeat frame follows only the first result, and stops in a dead end.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>：框里的元件做一步，得到的每一种结果再接着做；一条路走到头（证完，或者做不下去），再退回来换下一条。这叫<wiki-ref to="dfs"></wiki-ref>。它送出找到的每一个证完的状态。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>: the parts inside take a step, and each result is stepped on again; one path is followed to its end (done, or stuck) before going back for the next. This is <wiki-ref to="dfs"></wiki-ref>. It gives every finished state it finds.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
